description: This Java class implements a custom adapter for a GridViewPager in an Android Wear application, managing fragment creation and background images for each row and page, including asynchronous loading of drawable resources.

classes.name: SampleGridPagerAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter extending FragmentGridPagerAdapter to manage fragments and backgrounds for a grid view pager in an Android Wear app.

classes.name: Row
classes.description: A container class representing a row of fragments within the adapter.

classes.name: DrawableLoadingTask
classes.description: An AsyncTask subclass for loading drawable resources asynchronously.

methods.name: SampleGridPagerAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with context and fragment manager, setting up rows and default backgrounds.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Returns the fragment at specified row and column.

methods.name: getBackgroundForRow
methods.description: Returns the background drawable for a specific row.

methods.name: getBackgroundForPage
methods.description: Returns the background drawable for a specific page identified by row and column.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of rows.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in a specified row.

methods.name: cardFragment
methods.description: Creates a CardFragment with specified title and text resources.

methods.name: DrawableLoadingTask
methods.description: Loads drawable resources asynchronously in background thread.
